data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2021 were GBP 160.9m. Using the syndicate's gross claims development table, there is effectively no net prior-year movement on accident years up to 2019 (net prior year development ~ GBP 0.0m). Management's narrative notes favourable prior-year development on the 2019 and 2020 years driven by favourable subrogation outcomes from the 2018 wildfires, partially offset by adverse development on the Cyber book. Major 2021 catastrophe events (Hurricane Ida, Texas winter storms and European floods) produced a combined net impact of GBP 33.0m in 2021, but these are current-year losses rather than prior-year reserve movements.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' GROSS figure was provided. Prior year development was computed from the gross claims development table (note 9) which shows no net movement for underwriting years 2019 (net = 0.0). Management narrative describes favourable prior year development on 2019 and 2020 driven by subrogation on 2018 wildfires partly offset by adverse Cyber development, but no gross GBP  amounts are provided for these movements. Prior year development figure therefore derived from triangle (confidence 0.8).
